PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Analytical and detail-oriented former Secondary Mathematics & AP Statistics Educator transitioning into Data Analytics. Combines 6 years of quantitative data modeling, curriculum analytics, and stakeholder presentation experience with verified proficiency in SQL, Python, Tableau, and statistical hypothesis testing. Experienced translating intricate numerical insights into actionable strategic narratives.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Data Analysis & Scripting: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn), Excel (Advanced VLOOKUP, Index/Match, Pivot Tables, Power Query)
BI & Visualization: Tableau Desktop, Microsoft Power BI, Google Looker Studio
Statistical Methods: A/B Testing, Linear & Logistic Regression, Hypothesis Testing, Variance Analysis (ANOVA), Time Series Forecasting

DATA ANALYTICS PROJECTS
E-Commerce Customer Retention & Cohort Churn Model | Python, SQL & Tableau
- Extracted and cleaned 250,000 transaction records using SQL queries and Python Pandas to model customer repeat purchase behavior.
- Built an interactive Tableau executive dashboard tracking monthly active cohorts, churn velocity, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
- Uncovered that customers receiving welcome sequence emails retained at a 24% higher rate over 90 days, delivering insights adopted by 3 local retail stakeholders.

Urban Public Transit Mobility Trends | Python & Matplotlib
- Analyzed municipal open datasets containing 1.5M ride records to identify transit bottleneck corridors during peak morning commuting hours.
- Automated statistical anomaly detection scripts in Python, generating weekly mobility reports presented to civic interest groups.

- Department Lead for 8 educators: facilitated quarterly curriculum efficacy reviews using descriptive statistics to identify concept retention drop-offs.
- Communicated complex predictive learning analytics and academic trend trajectories to administrative boards, parents, and community leaders.

jobText:
Role: Data Analyst
Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)

About the Opportunity:
We are seeking a curious, data-driven Data Analyst to join our Business Operations and Growth Intelligence group. You will synthesize multi-channel operational data, design executive dashboards, and formulate recommendations that drive business decisions.

Core Responsibilities:
- Query relational databases (PostgreSQL/BigQuery) to extract, validate, and clean datasets for ad-hoc business reporting.
- Design and maintain production business intelligence dashboards in Tableau or Power BI.
- Formulate statistical analyses and cohort models to interpret customer behavior, retention trends, and operational KPIs.
- Present findings clearly to non-technical business partners and leadership.

Requirements:
- Strong analytical mindset with proven experience analyzing structured datasets using SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy) or R.
- Proficiency creating interactive data visualizations in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
- Solid grounding in descriptive and inferential statistics (hypothesis testing, regression, distributions).
- Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate quantitative insights clearly.
- Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical training/certifications.
